author_request: 2026-09-22: relax the total execution budget to at most two days and parallelize or optimize within available resources.

budget.accounting: New 48-hour wall-time allowance from the first numerical preflight of this campaign. Historical charged time is preserved and excluded. Benchmarks, simultaneous jobs, shutdown and reporting are inside this common clock; summed worker and CPU seconds are reported separately.

scientific_target.scope: Two single-realization DF recovery examples; no coverage or calibration claim. beta_ani=-0.5 is a common generation choice; validate DF before sampling. Untruncated analytic halo density; potential tends to zero at infinity. Negligible stellar self gravity.

spherical.parameter_mapping: Same coordinates and rectangular support as original. The nonconstant density is the joint Jeffreys volume in these named coordinates, including the systemic-velocity information block.

jeffreys.formula: log pi_J(theta)=logvolume[(partial log S_i / partial psi_j)/sqrt(2)] + 0.5 log sum_i(1/S_i); psi=first six coordinates; S_i=clip(sigma_los2_i,1e-12,1e12)+e_i^2
jeffreys.implementation: Column-scaled reduced QR; restore column-scale determinant exactly. No jitter, pseudodeterminant or numerical-rank threshold in the target. AD includes derivatives of the Fisher matrix. Known radii and errors held fixed.

baseline.initialization: Each independent ensemble draws equally from the preserved uniform and Jeffreys initial-point pools, using separate random seeds, then adds 0.01 prior-width jitter with reflection at bounds. Discard 400 new burn-in steps. Previous failed posteriors serve only as dispersed starting distributions and the mixture scaling estimate.
baseline.mixture_scale: Median log joint Jeffreys density at 32 fixed evenly spaced source points, 16 from each old prior. Fixed before any new chain.
baseline.marginalization: Exactly integrate systemic velocity on [-1000,1000] with the Gaussian likelihood; retain the systemic-velocity expected-information block in the Jeffreys density. Physical target remains the seven-coordinate prior; sampled coordinates are its six-dimensional marginal.
baseline.mixture: q(psi) proportional to L_marginal(psi)*[1+exp(log_pi_J(psi)-c)] times the common uniform-coordinate density. Posterior ratios use w_U=expit(c-log_pi_J), w_J=expit(log_pi_J-c); normalize each across saved draws. No original draws are included in estimates.
baseline.weighted_diagnostics: 20 batch means per independent ensemble for ratio-estimator influence. Require weight Kish fraction >=0.05 and mean MCSE/SD <=0.05 for all six coordinates and log density at 100 pc under both target priors, as well as all existing emcee gates. Two consecutive checkpoints required. Require each batch length >=2 times the estimated ratio-influence autocorrelation time.
baseline.reporting: Both DF realizations; paired weighted distributions of gamma, density and finite-radius slope. No core/cusp threshold, calibration/coverage rate or effectiveness claim from failed diagnostics. Preserve numerical rank issues and every attempted configuration.
baseline.no_retry: No time, seed, target or diagnostic changes after new posterior outcomes.
baseline.validation_seconds_note: Nominal planning allowance, included in each case and the overall hard cap; no separate extension.

initialization: Independent deterministic seeds. Equal mixture of the two preserved source point pools, with 1 percent prior-width jitter and reflection. New burn-in; old samples excluded from all posterior estimates.
interpretation: Two fixed DF realizations only. Convergence and numerical gates precede posterior comparison. No coverage/classification rate or general improvement claim. No new core/cusp decision threshold.
execution_selection: Choose CPU/GPU and map batch size from frozen-point timings before new sampling. No numerical precision, prior, likelihood, support, or quadrature changes.
stop_rule: Two consecutive complete four-ensemble diagnostic passes after at least 5000 production steps, 100000 steps, resource ceiling, or common wall deadline; preserve all checkpoints and failures. Reserve final 1800 seconds for assessment.

supersedes_budget_only.reason: Explicit user correction: 48 new hours, excluding all previous computation.
